FAQ

Questions,
answered.

Everything you need to know before booking a free strategy call.

Book a Free Strategy Call →
How quickly can I get new customer opportunities? +

Campaigns go live within the first 7 days. Real traction builds over the first few weeks as we test ads against each other and let the data pick the winners — we optimize for booked jobs, not overnight vanity numbers.

How much does it cost? +

It depends on what actually fits your business — your goals, your market, and which systems will move the needle for you. We figure out the right setup together on a quick call, so you're never paying for things you don't need.

Do you require long-term contracts? +

No. Everything's month to month. You stay because the phone's ringing and the math works — not because you're locked into a 12-month agreement.

Do you manage ad spend? +

Yes — I build and manage the campaigns and the budget day to day. The ad spend itself is paid directly to Meta/Google and stays in your account, fully visible to you; I manage how it's allocated to get you the lowest cost per booked job.

What types of businesses do you work with? +

Local service businesses — trades, home services, medical/dental, and appointment-based services. If your business runs on booked jobs and your phone needs to ring, there's a strong chance it's a fit.

How do results get tracked? +

Every call, form fill, and booked job is tracked back to the campaign that produced it. You always know what's working, what isn't, and exactly where your customers are coming from.

Who actually runs my ads? +

You work directly with the person building and managing your campaigns — not an offshore team. And because it's one client per niche per area, your account gets real attention.
